_comment: Rows a person read and accepted against a semantics-qa rule, keyed locale/wordId/rule, value = the reason. Same shape as unobserved.json.

rows.ru/word_jam/polarity: 잠이 잘 안 와요 → «я плохо сплю»: the negation is absorbed into плохо (sleep badly), which is the natural Russian rendering; a literal «сон не приходит» is not idiomatic.
rows.uk/word_jam/polarity: Same as Russian: «погано сплю» absorbs the negation naturally.
rows.de/word_jam/polarity: «schlafe schlecht ein» absorbs 안 와요 into schlecht; a literal negation (kein Schlaf kommt) is not German.
rows.vi/word_jam/polarity: «khó ngủ» (hard to sleep) is the natural Vietnamese for 잠이 잘 안 와요; the negation lives in khó.
rows.fr/word_jeonja/polarity: 보이지 않아요 → «invisible à l'œil»: the negation is the in- prefix, which is the natural French rendering.
